rule.text: The abstract says what an attendee leaves with, as a statement, not a promise to explain.

constraints.note: whether the takeaway is stated or only promised

rule.text: Every claim in the abstract is in the source piece; an abstract for a talk not yet given may not invent results.

constraints.note: claims the source does not make

delivery_notes: Printed in a programme and pasted into a review form. Read by a committee comparing forty of these in an afternoon, then by an attendee choosing between three rooms. No formatting survives; a single paragraph is all that is delivered.
